description: Held weapon locks on a vehicle (context/designs/modding/held-weapon-events.md, slice 6c), the single-player half. Boot makes the Blank Room with a hoverbike (as hoverbike_room_flow_smoke, under its own level name, and without mounting it). Player 0 takes the rocket launcher; with its targeted rocket selected and aim held (R) while aim_at keeps the view on the empty bike, the sight takes the bike as its one lock: SIGHT.LOCK names it a vehicle, unoccupied, related to nobody. Back on the primary (the straight rocket, no lock) the same aim takes no lock. The function's first aiming event logs its program's lock beside the original's, and no rule may differ at the scripted exit. The other half of the row (a second player riding: occupied, an enemy, the rocket flying straight once the rider bails) needs a second player and is not here.

input_sequence.comment: Boot makes the level (the Blank Room with a hoverbike), then first-person gameplay on foot.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_DEBUG_INVINCIBILITY
input_sequence.comment: Dev invincibility, in case a rocket goes off nearby. From the give to its first input there are 3 s (equip time).
The empty hoverbike, held for 4 s.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_SECONDARY
input_sequence.comment: Hold aim (R): the targeted rocket takes the bike as its lock.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_MODE
input_sequence.comment: Back to the straight rocket, which has no lock.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_SECONDARY
input_sequence.comment: Hold aim on the bike: the primary takes no lock.

required_lines: SMOKE\.AIM: begin target=vehicle slot=-1 chrnum=-1 pad=-?[0-9]+ dist=[0-9]+ los=1
WEAPON\.RULE: aiming weapon=base:rocketlauncher func=secondary program=yes lock=locks=1
SIGHT\.LOCK: player=0 weapon=base:rocketlauncher func=secondary slot=1 of 1 kind=vehicle occupied=0 relation=none
